title: Agent Manifest
description: A creator's declaration of what an agent does. Enforced by the platform, not merely claimed.

summary.description: Creator-authored. Reviewed and approved or rejected, never edited by Public.

underlying_allowlist.description: Optional. Recommended: it makes the agent legible to subscribers. Signals outside scope are rejected 403.

options_only_single_leg.description: Phase one supports single-leg options only. Multi-leg is phase 2.

frequency_band.description: LOW <10/week, MEDIUM <5/day, HIGH <20/day. Sets rate limits and listing eligibility. LOW and MEDIUM are the target cohorts for propose-and-confirm.

exit_policy.description: Displayed prominently at subscription. Until brackets ship, a creator-signalled exit still requires a second subscriber confirmation.

disclosure_block.description: Creator-authored risk disclosure. Public enforces presence and length, and does not supply the content.

auth_mode.description: PATH_TOKEN exists because TradingView webhooks cannot compute an HMAC. Signing required above a subscriber threshold.
